text: 金十数据9月26日讯，中共中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记陈文清24日主持召开专题会议，强调要认真学习贯彻习近平总书记关于食品安全工作的重要指示批示精神，依法从严查处危害食品安全违法犯罪，守护好人民群众“舌尖上的安全”。陈文清强调，要坚持严格执法，聚焦肉制品、校园食品、保健食品、蔬菜水果等重点领域，聚焦生产加工、网络销售、终端餐饮、食品进口等重点环节，全链条惩处危害食品安全违法犯罪。要加强行刑衔接，积极沟通市场监管、农业农村等部门，健全行政处罚与刑事处罚双向衔接机制，建立信息共享平台，强化食品安全依法治理。要推动综合整治，压实各方主体责任，完善食品安全全链
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 26 - Chen Wenqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, presided over a special meeting on the 24th, stressing the need to conscientiously study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and directives on food safety work, strictly investigate and punish illegal and criminal acts endangering food safety in accordance with the law, and safeguard the people's "safety on the tip of the tongue." Chen Wenqing stressed the need to adhere to strict law enforcement, focus on key areas such as meat products, campus food, health food, vegetables and fruits, focus on key links such as production and processing, online sales, terminal catering, and food imports, and punish illegal and criminal acts endangering food safety across the entire chain. It is necessary to strengthen the linkage between administrative and criminal enforcement, actively communicate with departments such as market regulation and agriculture and rural affairs, improve the two-way linkage mechanism between administrative penalties and criminal penalties, establish an information-sharing platform, and strengthen law-based food safety governance. It is necessary to promote comprehensive rectification, consolidate the main responsibilities of all parties, and improve the full chain of food safety
